section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: 11 ## Accidental Deaths by Sex : The percentage of male victims to the total number of victims of accidental deaths reported in the country during 1979 was 66·5 percent and of female victims was 33·5 percent. The ratio of male and female victims for the States as a whole was 66·3% and 33·7% respectively while for the U.Ts. as a whole it was 74·4% and 25·6% respectively. The percentage for the Metropolitan Cities taken together was the same as for the country as a whole i.e. 66·5% and 33·5% respectively.
